metadata.title: SAEFit Baseline Reproduction - Consolidated Experiment Results

unified_protocol.task: balanced binary classification, single pulse -> label 0, double pulse -> label 1, as in control/saefit.py::test_step
unified_protocol.oer_conditional: P(yhat != y | conf >= tau); NaN when no sample clears tau
unified_protocol.oer_absolute: P(yhat != y AND conf >= tau); monotone non-increasing in tau
unified_protocol.determinism: seed_eval_dataset() pins np.random and torch.manual_seed before every eval dataloader; verified bit-identical across runs

metadata.name: Calibration and Baseline
metadata.caveat: Labels derived from (dt > 0), which is constant 1; metrics were computed on a degenerate single-class task. Use experiment_13 instead.

metadata.name: OER Threshold Optimization (original)
metadata.caveat: Consumed prediction dumps built from the constant (dt > 0) label and returned 0.0 for empty high-confidence sets. Use experiment_14 instead.
